data.value: The permission is counted at the group. Members and membership routes do not add control-edge counts.

data.name: Complete
data.value: Resolved members: {0}. Unresolved identities: 0. Membership expansion is complete for the captured evidence.

data.name: Partial
data.value: Partial member expansion — {0} resolved members found; {1} unresolved identities retained; {2} membership candidates remain unconfirmed. These are not total effective-membership counts.

data.name: BudgetStop
data.value: Expansion stopped because the configured {0} budget was reached. Results found before the stop are retained.

data.name: UnknownApplicability
data.value: Membership is recorded, but its use for this resource could not be established: {0}.

data.name: NotApplicable
data.value: This membership does not make the group usable in the recorded resource context.

data.name: Applicable
data.value: Group route usable in the recorded resource context; not a complete access check.

data.name: NotRun
data.value: Member expansion did not run. No expansion budget was approved. Group-held permissions remain visible and counted as before.

data.name: NotStarted
data.value: This group was not expanded because the run’s expansion budget was exhausted. Its member count is unknown.

data.name: Empty
data.value: No effective security-group members were found. Membership expansion is complete for the captured evidence.

data.name: InvalidEvidence
data.value: Stored member evidence could not be validated. Member counts and routes are unavailable; this is not an empty result.

data.name: SelectPermission
data.value: Select a group-held permission to read its stored members.

data.name: NoGroup
data.value: The holder was not resolved as a captured permission-holding group. No member total is asserted.

data.name: RoutesHeading
data.value: Membership routes — grouped by initial membership

data.name: RoutesCaveat
data.value: These are supporting membership chains, not an enumeration of every path. Removing a displayed membership is not a claim that all access is removed.

data.name: Caveat
data.value: Membership attribution only. A member’s complete effective permissions and operation success have not been evaluated here. No directory operation was performed.
